stem:
[Image: Coordinate grid with points P, Q, R, and S]

Which of the following represents the point (3, −2) on the graph?
figure_description:
A Cartesian coordinate plane with horizontal axis x and vertical axis y intersecting at origin O. Each axis has three tick marks in each direction from the origin representing unit increments of 1, 2, 3 and -1, -2, -3. Four points are plotted:
- Point P is at coordinates (3, 2).
- Point Q is at coordinates (3, -2).
- Point R is at coordinates (-3, -2).
- Point S is at coordinates (-3, 2).
